name: Replica Club √D
source:
Hollywood. Bright lights, sold-out shows, magazine covers.

Suzuno Kurezuki has just landed the job of a lifetime — personal manager to Cain, the biggest star on the theater strip.

But every night, she wakes somewhere else.

Dark alleys. Nameless flowers. And a man who wears Cain's face but speaks with a stranger's voice.

His name is Dysphoria. His demand is simple:

"Show me your sin."

What Suzuno hides by day, the night tears open. And as the border between her two worlds begins to crack, everything she believed was real starts to come apart — quietly, irreversibly.

Can you love something ugly?

This is the story of finding your answer.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3923910/Replica_Club_D_D/]Steam[/url]]
